description: This file contains test cases for the tailnet helper functions such as detecting Tailnet IPv4 addresses, listing Tailnet addresses, and picking primary Tailnet addresses. It leverages the 'vitest' testing framework and mocks network interface data.

methods.name: listTailnetAddresses
methods.description: Lists all non-internal Tailnet IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from network interfaces.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks whether a given IP address belongs to the Tailnet IPv4 range.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Selects the first available IPv4 address within the Tailnet.

methods.name: pickPrimaryTailnetIPv6
methods.description: Selects the first available IPv6 address within the Tailnet.
